raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Since 2026-01-17 the source sends amount corrections as a repeat of the txn_id with record_version=2. There are 4975 distinct txn_ids across 5003 rows, so 28 txn_ids have a v1 and a v2 row. silver_transactions keeps both versions, which gives 27 duplicate keys among POSTED rows. The fix keeps only the latest version per txn_id, and does this before the POSTED filter so a later REVERSED version correctly removes the transaction.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.82,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC, ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) AS rn FROM raw_transactions) WHERE rn = 1 AND status = 'POSTED'"}}
